summary.plain: With 33 live-days of reactor-on data PROSPECT detected about 25,000 antineutrino interactions and compared their energy spectra at different distances from the reactor. It excluded part of the parameter space for a fourth, sterile neutrino and disfavoured the best-fit point of the reactor antineutrino anomaly at 2.2 sigma.
summary.technical: Reactor-model-independent analysis of the IBD prompt-energy spectrum versus baseline (7-9 m) constrains significant portions of the previously allowed sterile-neutrino parameter space at 95 % CL and disfavours the Reactor Antineutrino Anomaly best fit at 2.2 sigma.

title: First search for short-baseline neutrino oscillations at HFIR with PROSPECT
why_it_matters: An early direct test of the reactor antineutrino anomaly from one compact core, without relying on a reactor flux model.
